frozen_before_execution: this file is committed to the cycle branch BEFORE any execution of evaluation.disclosure_provenance_crosscheck; the git commit time is the freeze evidence, not a hand-written timestamp field
fast_mvp_statement: Smallest executable cross-check that can FALSIFY the newest claim-bearing product artifact citing Evaluation-owned numbers: Product's unaudited counter-instability disclosure (run 39422322667) transcribes Evaluation's accepted open items 5/6 and publishes their REPORTED-ONLY quantities on the packet-of-record V3. This instrument verifies, side-by-side and byte-reproducibly, that every published quantity and provenance claim reproduces from Evaluation's own committed evidence and from origin/main's accepted-state. Divergence is the headline; no threshold, bar, rubric or verdict contract is re-derived.
question: Does Product's shipped counter-instability disclosure (results/product/disclosures/CYCLE_39422322667_counter_instability_disclosure.json on the accepted product mount, plus the regenerated packet disclosure layer for 39319405429) faithfully reproduce Evaluation-owned evidence - the two open items verbatim, every P1/P1ext structured quantity re-derivable from results/evaluation/cross_run_stability_sweep/39322925971.json, the accepted-state pin provenance, and the packet scored-byte identity - or does any published claim fail to reproduce from the committed tree?
product_decision_unlocked: Whether Product's ordered-work-(3) disclosure (the P1/P1ext disclosure Product was ordered to ship beside the coverage-gap disclosure) can be treated as an honest, evaluation-verified transcription - or whether it carries a false-provenance / non-reproducible-claim defect of the class that has repeatedly blocked product cycles (factory-wide requirement 33). A ZERO_DIVERGENCE result lets Product cite its own disclosure block without an audit caveat; a DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE names the exact rows Product must repair. Either outcome is first-class evidence; neither unblocks any gate.

freeze_time_observations.note: These are OBSERVATIONS recorded at freeze time, not frozen equality requirements. The subject under test is whatever the accepted product mount carries at run time; a change against a freeze-time observation is published as disclosed drift with both digests, never silently accepted and never treated as an environment error.

success_rule_frozen.VERDICT_DISCLOSURE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED_Z: F1-F5 all FALSE; every comparable row matches; non-vacuity controls all hold; exit 0
success_rule_frozen.VERDICT_DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE: at least one of F1-F5 TRUE; every diverging row is named in the headline with both sides; exit 1
success_rule_frozen.ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: the product mount is absent, a required evaluation-owned file is missing/unreadable, or the pin commit cannot be fetched after an explicit fetch attempt; exit 2; NEVER a product verdict
success_rule_frozen.rule: the rule is fixed here, before execution, and is not revised after any result is observed. A partially-divergent result is reported as DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE naming exactly the diverging rows; it is never rounded up to ZERO_DIVERGENCE.

precision_rules_frozen.jaccard_floats: equality after round(value, 6) on both sides (the open-items text itself publishes 6dp)
precision_rules_frozen.share_floats: equality after round(value, 3) on both sides (the open-items text itself publishes 3dp: 0.747 / 0.758)
precision_rules_frozen.id_lists: set equality, order-insensitive; duplicates preserved as a multiset check
precision_rules_frozen.strings: exact byte equality after UTF-8 encoding
precision_rules_frozen.no_thresholds: zero new thresholds; the precision ladder is a comparability definition for this cross-check only and never becomes a product gate

non_vacuity_contract.N1: a scratch copy of the disclosure with p1ext.retrieved_set_jaccard.fr perturbed (e.g. 0.5) MUST be flagged by the comparator as a Q2 divergence
non_vacuity_contract.N2: a scratch copy with open item 5 text perturbed (one word removed) MUST be flagged as a V1 divergence
non_vacuity_contract.N3: a scratch copy with file_sha256_at_pin replaced by a wrong digest MUST be flagged as a P1 divergence
non_vacuity_contract.N4: a scratch copy with fr_counter_evidence_lost missing one id MUST be flagged as a Q7 divergence
non_vacuity_contract.N5: a comparator that cannot report DIFFERENT on all four planted perturbations invalidates the run (verdict NON_VACUOUS, exit 1)

safety_contract.S1_never_write_evaluation_owned_evidence: results/evaluation/cross_run_stability_sweep/39322925971.json, state/evaluation.json, evaluation/frozen_bars/* and every accepted run record are read-only; their sha256 is captured BEFORE and AFTER the run and the record publishes both manifests' equality
safety_contract.S2_never_edit_the_product_mount: the mount under /tmp/lex_accepted/product is read-only; non-vacuity perturbations happen on in-memory/scratch copies only
safety_contract.S3_never_overwrite_claim_bearing_records: the live run is written only to results/evaluation/disclosure_provenance_crosscheck/39516448683.json (a NEW run-id path); no prior artifact is modified
safety_contract.S4_freeze_first: this hypothesis and its freeze record are committed before the instrument is executed; the instrument re-hashes the hypothesis and refuses to run if its bytes moved
safety_contract.S5_no_network_except_pin_fetch: the only network operation permitted is `git fetch --depth=1 origin <pin-commit>` when the shallow clone lacks the commit; no OpenCaseLaw, no model calls

standing_rules_applied.requirement_25_26: this cross-check measures NO bar; it publishes no support-among-issued triple because it scores no labels; NOT_APPLICABLE/NOT_MEASURED/INSUFFICIENT_POPULATION are never a pass anywhere in this record
standing_rules_applied.rederive_nothing: no threshold, bar, rubric, predicate, incumbent or verdict contract is re-derived, edited, re-tuned or 'clarified'; the frozen pins are re-hashed byte-identically and published
standing_rules_applied.no_174k: no universal-174k benchmark is rerun; no geometry is rescored; no candidate is built
standing_rules_applied.ordered_work_4_respected: the P1/P1ext numbers stay REPORTED-ONLY first-class evidence measured of record by run 39322925971; this instrument RE-VERIFIES the product's published transcription against that artifact and never re-measures the underlying runs, never re-computes population statistics from run outputs, and never replaces the artifact of record
standing_rules_applied.fail_closed_posture: both DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand; human_gate_ready=false, machine_gate_ready=false, packet_admitted=false, ready_for_owner_session=false, owner_decision_required=false regardless of this cross-check's verdict

claim_ceiling: This instrument verifies PROVENANCE FIDELITY of Product's published disclosure against Evaluation-owned committed evidence. It does NOT re-measure P1/P1ext, does NOT judge whether the instability disclosure is legally useful, does NOT score any label or geometry bar, does NOT meet or unblock any frozen bar, does NOT serve a packet, lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order and authorises no owner question.
exit_rule: exit 0 only on VERDICT_DISCLOSURE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED_ZERO_DIVERGENCE with all non-vacuity controls holding; exit 1 on DIVERGENCE_HEADLINE or NON_VACUOUS; exit 2 only on ENVIRONMENT_ERROR. A divergence is a result, never an error.
